propositions: BindingRepository must own and directly manage live, retired, rotation, and alert files with exact byte-level serialization and sorted/indented/newline format preservation across load and save cycles.
Rotation persistence failure must leave the rotation sidecar unchanged and live replaced with new bytes retaining the inline last_get_pass floor, without raising an exception.
After rotation persistence failure, a subsequent save must recover by writing the retained inline last_get_pass to the rotation sidecar before live replacement, achieving convergence.
Corrupt live state must raise ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired state must fail open (return empty), attempt best-effort deduped alerting, and preserve the file.
Retired or live persistence failure must clean temporary files and raise an exception, while alert persistence failure must be swallowed without altering the successful state-file result.
The repository must enforce ordered persistence (retired before live, rotation before live) without eager writes on construction and without multi-file atomicity or journal mechanisms.
